what: The mouse trail stays like a pen-tool path — points kept for 520ms are joined by midpoint quadratic curves (1.25px, alpha .9 fading with age), and going backward along the trail a 6px anchor square is placed every 72px, while the most recent anchor gets tangent-direction ±22px handle lines and end circles (r 2.4). On press, two rings (delay 0 and 90ms, the second at .56 size) spread over 760ms from 6px to 190px by (1−(1−t)^4), fading as line 2.6→.6px and alpha .95→0, and the center dot (r 10) shrinks over 380ms. Because of difference blending, it shows the opposite color on any background

options.max: Max number of trail points, default 160
options.color: Line color — default --kf-contrast-ink (appears inverted through difference)

note: Attach it to a single canvas element (one per page). Hidden on touch devices and with reduced motion. The original anchor is black fill + difference so the background shows through, while here the anchor’s inside is erased to get the same look

from.where: index.html canvas.gs-ink (original canvas.ink — trail 520ms · max 160 · 72px anchor · ±22 handle · ring 0/90ms 760ms 190px · center dot 380ms, mix-blend difference, signal color #fff)
